description: This source file implements trust store handling for macOS, including trust evaluation, caching, and keychain event monitoring within the Chromium project.

classes.name: TrustStoreMac::ResultDebugData
classes.description: Holds debug information related to trust evaluation results.

classes.name: TrustStoreMac::TrustImpl
classes.description: Abstract interface for trust setting retrieval implementations.

classes.name: TrustStoreMac::TrustImplDomainCacheFullCerts
classes.description: Caches trust info for certificates in a trust domain using SecTrustSettingsCopyCertificates.

classes.name: TrustStoreMac::TrustImplKeychainCacheFullCerts
classes.description: Caches trust info for certificates by querying the keychain with SecItemCopyMatching.

classes.name: TrustStoreMac::TrustImplNoCache
classes.description: Implements trust checking by directly calling SecTrustSettingsCopyTrustSettings without caching.

methods.name: TrustStoreMac::GetTrust
methods.description: Returns trust information for a given certificate based on trust settings.

methods.name: TrustStoreMac::SyncGetIssuersOf
methods.description: Retrieves issuer certificates for a given certificate.

methods.name: TrustStoreMac::InitializeTrustCache
methods.description: Initializes or refreshes the trust cache.
